public_rationale: On May 23, 2024, The Verge recorded Google's recommendation to mix about 1/8 cup of glue into pizza sauce and identified an older Reddit comment as its apparent source [e5]. On May 24, Ars Technica linked the recommendation of 1/8 cup of non-toxic glue to stop cheese sliding off pizza to an 11-year-old Reddit post [e6]. The distinctive ingredient, quantity and purpose support describing the answer as a close reworking of that source [e5, e6].
limitations: The original Reddit thread could not be read directly; the comparison relies on contemporary reporting.
No internal Google trace establishes the exact source path or whether the content came through training or search.
Reported answer variants differ in wording and should not be treated as identical transcripts.
Ars reports reproducing many examples but does not explicitly establish that it reproduced this particular answer.
